warband.name: Mercenaries

subtypes.name: Reikland
subtypes.note: Fighters may use the Captain’s Leadership within 12" instead of 6"; all Marksmen +1 BS.

subtypes.name: Middenheim
subtypes.note: Champions and the Captain start with Strength 4 instead of 3.

subtypes.name: Marienburg
subtypes.note: +100 gc (600 total) in the campaign. +1 when finding rare items.

warband.rules: Choice: Exactly 1 Captain. Max. 2 Champions, max. 2 Youngbloods, max. 7 Marksmen, max. 5 Swordsmen, any number of Warriors.

units.name: Mercenary Captain
units.sp: Leader: Friendly models within 6" (12" in a Reikland warband) may use his Leadership.

units.name: Swordsman
units.sp: Expert Swordsmen: May re-roll any failed hits when charging, but only when armed with normal swords (not double-handed swords or other weapons).

intro.text: Hard men from all over the Empire come to Mordheim for the rewards offered for wyrdstone. Mercenaries hire out to one of three claimants to the imperial throne, Reikland, Middenheim or Marienburg, and each lands its warbands with its own look and character.

unitLore.capt: A Mercenary Captain is a tough professional warrior, a man who will fight for anyone or against anything so long as the price is right. Mordheim offers such a man the chance to become rich beyond his dreams, though at great risk. But as ruthlessness and lack of mercy and pity are the hallmarks of a successful Mercenary Captain, it is no wonder that they flock to Mordheim.
unitLore.champ: In any Mercenary warband there is one warrior who is bigger, stronger (and often uglier) than his comrades. These men are called Champions (or berserkers, first swordsmen and various other names). Champions are amongst the toughest and the best fighters in the warband. They often answer challenges issued to the warband and, after the Captain, they get the pick of any equipment and loot.
unitLore.young: These are young fighters who are still inexperienced, but eager to win their spurs in the savage fighting in and around the ruins of Mordheim.
unitLore.warr: These dogs of war are grim, seasoned fighters, fearing no man as long as they have their weapons and armour. They form the core of any Mercenary warband.
unitLore.mark: The archers and hunters of the Old World are famed for their skill, and it is said that they can hit a coin from 300 paces with a long bow. In the savage street fights of Mordheim they snipe at the enemy from the windows of ruined buildings and pick out enemy leaders with their arrows.
unitLore.sword: Swordsmen are professional warriors, experts at taking on and beating several opponents at once. They are much sought after by warband leaders, as their skills are ideally suited for fighting in Mordheim.
